title: Two Runs Out of Nenana

roles.sky: #F2A779 apricot civil-twilight band low on the horizon, rising through dusky mauve #8A6283 to plum night #3B2B4A at the top of frame; never cyan, teal or cobalt
roles.ground: #D9D0E3 lavender snow and river ice, shade #A79BB8, a warm peach catch #F6D9C4 where the twilight hits; spruce black #1F2621 treelines and ink
roles.hero: #C8E3F0 clear glass sample tubes with an oxblood fill #7E1626 and a cream cap #F3EBDD, full ink outline and a #20182B contact shadow; staged only against plum falloff, a dusk sky, the crate interior or the fridge glow, never on open snow; never frosted
roles.ribbon: #E0303F scarlet, ONLY the throughline ribbon and its loop; nothing else in the film is scarlet
roles.accent: #2EE86B radar-phosphor green on dark or dusk grounds and #13A84A on snow or map, every dash with a 3 px #20182B plum-ink keyline, ONLY what is PLANNED or seen by a machine: the dashed radar, its dashes, the sight bubble's edge (Gate 0D: mint #5FE0C2 had no value contrast on lavender snow and sat in the last two films' cool family and 11-18's mint)
roles.sepia: #B98A57 ONLY 1925 (the dog team, mushers, the train and the paw trail ink), so the past always reads as the past
roles.map: the giant map is cream paper #F1E6D2 laid on the lavender ice, its land a faded sage #B9C3A2 with sepia rivers, water a pale mauve-grey #BDB3C8
roles.aircraft: #9A96A0 quiet grey CargoDrone with an apricot rim, staged in silhouette against the apricot band #F2A779, never against mauve
roles.august: the August 19th sequence (runway, flats, hangar, ground station) is summer: green spruce #2F5A3A and birch, tan-green flats #8FA36A, a dry grey runway, the same apricot sky; NO snow or ice. Snow returns only at the 40-below beat.

palette.mood: a long Interior dusk on the river ice at Nenana: cold air, warm low light, a quiet place where two journeys started a century apart
palette.why: Apricot and plum because an Alaska winter dusk is the hour of this story (the 1925 relay ran in January dark), and it diverges hard from 11-22's cyan-grey and teal lab and 11-21's birch, walnut and mustard. Scarlet belongs to the ribbon alone so the throughline is the most saturated thing in every frame. Mint means machine sight and PLANNED, so the radar can never be mistaken for installed hardware. Sepia means 1925, so the two runs never blur. Blood is oxblood, a darker red than the ribbon, so the ribbon never reads as blood. Phosphor green replaces mint for machine sight (Gate 0D).

light.map_on_ice: key: the low apricot sun from frame left, raking long shadows of pins, the dog team and the drone's shadow across the cream map; fill: cool lavender bounce off the ice; rim: apricot on every upright.
light.runway_depot: key: apricot from the low sun behind the depot, the ULTRA in near silhouette with an apricot rim on the wing; fill: runway edge lights and a hangar door spill.
light.ground_station: interior key: the console's soft white screen glow on the faceless pilot; fill: a window behind showing the dusk runway; rim: apricot through the window.
light.test_table: key: a cold blue-grey window light from the side onto the tubes and the printer, no hanging lamp (11-22 used a lamp-lit bench); the room falls off to plum.
light.village: key: apricot horizon behind the roofs, warm yellow clinic window light as the focal glow; fill: lavender snow bounce.
light.depth: three planes everywhere: the near ice or snow drifts and a fence in the lower third, the subject plane, and the far spruce line and Alaska Range silhouette under the dusk sky, with parallax on every camera move.
light.1925: a flat sepia-graded key with a vignette and paper grain, no rim, so 1925 reads as an old print
light.turn: the Turn plays on the map on the ice: the ribbon reaches from NENANA toward the village roofs and snags on the phosphor edge of the sight bubble drawn on the map around the ground station's town

shape_language: LINE vs LOOP: the 1925 run, the rail, the runway and the trail are long straight lines; the drone's flight, the ribbon's closed loop, the sight bubble and the radar sweep are circles. Living things (tubes, dogs, the moose) are round and soft. The thesis is a loop that has the length of the line and hasn't been allowed to become one. The moose is cut (Gate 0D: 11-21 used it as its Alaska cue); the dog team, the raven and the Tanana carry Alaska. The ribbon is NEVER pulled straight on the map: laid out, it follows the curving trail and stops about nine tenths of the way along (621 of 674), so it can't read as farther than the dogs or as a delivery.

casting.hero: FLEW and STAYED, a NET-NEW reusable library pair (lib/serum.tsx `SampleTube`): CLEAR glass sample tubes with cream caps, oxblood fill, eyes and a mouth on the glass, moods (eager, nervous, calm, wistful, worried, proud), goggles, tags. No frost on either tube anywhere in the film, so nothing reads as cold exposure of the sample. Gap: the shelf has no small faced container that can be a blood sample; FlightCrate is a crate, and the pair carries the two-sample comparison the claims make.
casting.ai_presence: RADAR, NET-NEW (lib/serum.tsx `RadarEye`): a small dish with one eye, drawn ENTIRELY in phosphor-green dashes with plum keylines and a PLANNED tag plate in every frame it appears, never solid, never mounted on or settling on the aircraft. It is absent from the whole August 19th sequence (the only thing seeing then is the faceless pilot at the screen; the sight bubble first rises at beat 35); it enters at the Turn, passes through the wing dashed and keeps moving, and keeps its dashes and PLANNED tag in the button. The 'loses link' condition is drawn as a dashed link line from the ground station antenna to the drone that breaks; the 'other aircraft' it avoids is a dashed ghost airplane silhouette, never a bird.
casting.aircraft: NET-NEW (lib/serum.tsx `CargoDrone`): a plain, accurate twin-engine high-wing cargo drone, #9A96A0 grey with an apricot rim, 31 ft scale. NO eyes, NO mouth, NO cheek decals. It is a company's product and stays a machine.
casting.supporting_shelf: SledDogTeam (fauna.tsx) for the 1925 relay drawn sepia with faceless mushers in plain generic parkas (no patterned trim, no kuspuk, no carved or beadwork motifs); FlightCrate (clinic.tsx) as FLEW's ride; Suit (lib/people.tsx, face={false}) for a faceless Cathy Cahill and the faceless pilot with boxed name tags; AK_PATH (lib/akmap.ts) for the map on the ice; Raven (fauna.tsx) passing the ground station window; Drone (polecam.tsx) for small drones.
casting.net_new_support: lib/serum.tsx also gets `Ribbon` (the scarlet throughline, a polyline that morphs loop to line, last stretch can dash), `SightBubble` (a phosphor-edged dome), `ResultTray` (a small lab results printer whose output tray stays empty by a cold side window, a LAB RESULTS · NOT PUBLISHED plate; replaces a face-down card, which Gate 0D called a three-film idiom), `GroundStation` (console, screens, mug), `Village` (roofs, a clinic with a warm window and a short runway; no totems, regalia, patterned textiles or Native symbols; TCC appears only as a text plate), `SampleFridge`, `Train1925` and `Engine1925`. Shelf gap proof (grep of ASSET_INDEX.md for village, clinic building, printer, console, fridge, cargo drone, radar dish): only FlightCrate, the clinic family's TypeSlug, FieldRadiograph and AllowanceBoard, polecam's small Drone and evidence_state's SeedDrone exist; none is a village, a ground station, a printer, a fridge, a fixed-wing cargo drone or a radar dish.
casting.small_drone: Shelf `Drone` (lib/polecam.tsx), a small quadcopter, for c26 SMALL DRONES FLOWN AT 40 BELOW · PER CAHILL; the CargoDrone is never used for that beat.

motion_language: The dogs gallop and the line draws forward; the drone glides and the ribbon curls. The tubes react in squash and quick blinks; the printer hums and its tray never fills; the radar's dashes march but never join. The ribbon pulls taut with a twang and snaps back with an overshoot. 180-degree blur on the ribbon snap and the drone pass; anticipation before every stamp.

composition.focal_hierarchy: the ribbon is always the most saturated thing; the tubes or the drone are the subject; plates sit at y 560 to 760 in the overlay band
composition.negative_space: the empty Nenana runway with one edge light after the drone lands, and the bare cream map after the ribbon snaps home
composition.safe_area: hero action and plates inside y 420 to 1500; tubes, dogs and the drone never below y 1300; the lower band is ice drifts, the runway fence or the console edge
composition.signature_shot: Two scales on the map on the ice. Wide: the scarlet ribbon un-loops and slides ALONG the curving sepia paw trail, stopping about nine tenths of the way with bare sepia trail ahead to NOME, plates 1,000 KM LOOP · LAID ALONG THE TRAIL, ABOUT 621 MILES, NENANA TO NOME · 674 MILES. Push in on the frayed end: the lead dog sniffs it, then the ribbon twangs back into a loop on NENANA. No derived 'miles short' figure.

craft_advance: One reusable family, lib/serum.tsx, registered in ASSET_MANIFEST.md; no engine system advanced.
treatment: Two Runs Out of Nenana (Dramatist winner, grafted with the Comedian's string gag and the Explainer's sight bubble, restaged at Gate 0B). A cream map on the frozen Tanana at dusk: a sepia dog team inks a curving paw trail all the way to Nome, then a drone's shadow glances at an unlit village pin and closes ONE LOOP on NENANA. 1925 in sepia (diphtheria, train to Nenana, 20 mushers, 674 miles, a small airplane engine at 40 below). August 19th in summer green: the plain ULTRA rolls out at the Nenana runway, crosses the Tanana flats from above, a faceless pilot flies it from a screen, FLEW and STAYED split between a crate and a fridge, 8 HR 47 MIN. The signature: the ribbon lays itself along the trail and stops about nine tenths of the way, the lead dog sniffs the end, and it snaps back into A TEST LOOP. Small drones at 40 below. The Test by a cold window: Cahill lifts both clear tubes under her quote, steps away, the printer's tray stays empty (LAB RESULTS · NOT PUBLISHED), the empty crate turns to NOT TESTED FOR DOPING. The village, 82 percent off the road. A new strand reaches for the village and snags on a sight bubble (federal rules). A dashed radar, PLANNED, ghosts through the wing, a link line breaks, the arc tracks a dashed ghost airplane. Partners as plates over a dark village runway. The button: ribbon solid inside the bubble, dashed phosphor to the clinic.
